title: Multi-source driver pack: genes + curated variants + pathway membership
context: Individual packs (driver genes, curated variants, pathway membership) each provide value, but combining them into one multi-source pack lets researchers and educators see the full picture in a single browser session: which cancer driver genes exist, what curated variants have been observed there, and which pathways they participate in. This requires combining CC0 (Open Targets, CIViC) and CC-BY (Reactome) sources, each with their own license attribution in the combined manifest, with no NC or controlled-access content present.
objective: Build a multi-source cancer driver pack combining driver gene models (Open Targets/GENCODE), curated variants (CIViC CC0), and Reactome pathway membership (CC-BY) into a single manifest on hg38 and hg19, emitting all three browser targets.
acceptanceCriteria: Combines at least three tracks from distinct approved sources (driver gene models, CIViC curated variants, Reactome pathway membership); each track in the manifest carries its own source license and attribution; no NC or controlled-access source present.
Each constituent source has a committed licensegate-002 PASS artifact; combined pack has a coordgate-003 PASS artifact for both hg38 and hg19.
All three browser targets emitted (UCSC + JBrowse 2 + IGV) and render-verified on hg38; features from all three tracks appear at expected loci with evidence in outcomes/pack-017.json.
Per-feature provenance is maintained per source (each feature traceable to its open source record); provenance completeness score ≥ 90/100.
Pack carries not-medical-advice notice; hosted at a loadable URL; adoption evidence or blocker recorded.
output: output/packs/multi-source-driver-hg38/ and output/packs/multi-source-driver-hg19/ — combined track files, browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/pack-017.json.
